story: As a student, I want to log into the portal so I can access my assignments.
As a teacher, I want to upload lecture notes so students can download them easily.
As an admin, I want to manage user accounts so I can maintain security.
As a student, I want to track my project progress so I can meet deadlines.
As a mentor, I want to review project submissions so I can give feedback.
As a student, I want to submit my final project report online.
As an admin, I want to send notifications to all users for important updates.
As a teacher, I want to create quizzes so I can assess student learning.
As a student, I want to view quiz results instantly after submission.
As a teacher, I want to schedule presentations for project evaluations.
As a student, I want to collaborate with teammates through a group chat.
As a mentor, I want to assign project grades directly in the system.
As a student, I want to update my profile with my academic details.
As an admin, I want to generate overall performance reports of students.
As a teacher, I want to track attendance during project review sessions.
As a student, I want to download project resources shared by the faculty.
As a mentor, I want to comment on project tasks for improvement.
As an admin, I want to manage access control for students and faculty.
As a student, I want to get deadline reminders for submissions.
As a teacher, I want to mark late submissions in the portal.
As a student, I want to receive feedback notifications automatically.
As a mentor, I want to filter student submissions by project title.
As an admin, I want to back up all project data securely.
As a teacher, I want to review group project progress weekly.
As a student, I want to upload multiple files in a single submission.
As a mentor, I want to export project summaries in PDF format.
As an admin, I want to track system usage for analytics.
As a teacher, I want to verify originality of student projects.
As a student, I want to share my project demo video.
As a mentor, I want to approve final project completion for evaluation.
